description_en: Starts the one-click scan feature on the vulnerability management page of the console
description_zh: 开启控制台漏洞管理页面的一键扫描功能
kebab_example: aliyun sas modify-start-vul-scan --types cve,sys,cms,app,emg --uuids 1587bedb-fdb4-48c4-9330-0000 --client-token example-string --resource-directory-account-id 1 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyStartVulScan

parameters.help_en:
Settings for the types of vulnerabilities to detect by using the one-click scan feature. Valid values:
cve: Linux software vulnerability.
sys: Windows system vulnerability.
cms: Web-CMS vulnerability.
app: application vulnerability detected by the web scanner.
emg: urgent vulnerability.
image: container image vulnerability.
sca: application vulnerability detected by software constituency parsing.
If this parameter is left empty, all vulnerability types are detected
parameters.help_zh:
设置一键扫描功能检测的漏洞类型。可设置以下取值：
cve：Linux软件漏洞。
sys：Windows系统漏洞。
cms：Web-CMS漏洞。
app：通过Web扫描器检测的应用漏洞。
emg：应急漏洞。
image：容器镜像漏洞。
sca：通过软件成分分析检测的应用漏洞。
如果该取值为空，会检测所有漏洞类型
parameters.name: types

parameters.help_en:
The UUIDs of the servers. Separate multiple UUIDs with commas (,).

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/421726.html operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
服务器UUID列表,多个UUID之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔。


您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/421726.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: uuids

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Different requests should use different tokens. The token supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 客户端 Token，用于保证请求幂等性。不同请求应使用不同的 Token；只支持 ASCII 字符，长度不超过 64 个字符
parameters.name: client_token

RequestId.description_en: The unique request ID generated by Alibaba Cloud for this request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符
